citation: Based on Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google public model pricing and latency benchmarks (October 2026)

rules.rationale: Regex generation, grep scripts, and simple bash commands require minimal reasoning depth. Using Haiku or Flash cuts token cost by ~80% and responds with <800ms latency without quality degradation.
rules.caveats: If regex involves Unicode edge cases or high-performance backtracking security, review with a test suite.

rules.rationale: Unit testing requires understanding parameter boundaries, mocking interfaces, and reproducing error states. Sonnet provides optimal balance of precise mocking without over-engineering.
rules.caveats: Always run test suite locally via `npm test` or `mvn test` to verify zero mock drift.

rules.rationale: Modern UI components demand precise CSS/Tailwind layout, state synchronization, and WCAG accessibility standards. Sonnet produces clean, responsive JSX/TSX with proper ARIA attributes.
rules.caveats: Check responsiveness on mobile viewports (390x844) and verify contrast ratios.

rules.rationale: Backend endpoints require DTO validation, error handling, status code semantics (400 vs 422), and clean service layer delegation. Claude Code excels at following existing repo idioms.
rules.caveats: Ensure validation constraints (e.g. Bean Validation or Zod) are strictly asserted.

rules.rationale: Database schema migrations have high blast radius. AI should draft the SQL DDL, indexes, and rollback script, but never be applied without human review.
rules.caveats: NEVER allow AI to run `DROP TABLE` or `TRUNCATE` in production. Always verify backward compatibility (expand/contract pattern).

rules.rationale: Refactoring across multiple files benefits from Claude Code's project-wide grep and file edit tools. Prompt caching reduces cost on repeated file inspection.
rules.caveats: Commit all clean working changes to git before starting a refactoring session to enable instant rollback.

rules.rationale: Project scaffolding works best when following established production playbooks with explicit directory conventions and build files.
rules.caveats: Ensure `.gitignore` and `CLAUDE.md` are initialized immediately to prevent token bloat.

rules.rationale: System design, distributed transaction handling, and domain boundaries require deep chain-of-thought reasoning. Higher model capacity prevents subtle architectural anti-patterns.
rules.caveats: Document all trade-offs in an Architecture Decision Record (ADR) committed to version control.
